notes: The 1985 RD is 'RD report-name-1 [CODE literal-1] [CONTROL ...] [PAGE [LIMIT IS|LIMITS ARE] integer-1 [LINE|LINES] [HEADING integer-2] [FIRST DETAIL integer-3] [LAST DETAIL integer-4] [FOOTING integer-5]]' (§1985:XIII.3.5.2 '[ FIRST DETAIL integer-3 ] [ LAST DETAIL integer-4 ]'; phrase order free by §1985:XIII.3.8.3 SR1). The grammar is the 2023 format; BindReportDescriptionClauses enforces the CONTROL shape (FINAL first, COBOL2421, the witness), each clause and phrase at most once (COBOL2423) and BindCodeClause refuses CODE identifier and a numeric CODE (COBOL2713), and all 1985 forms probed compile and run (bare PAGE 60, LIMITS ARE ... LINE, free phrase order, IS GLOBAL, no clauses). But VersionConformancePass has no edition arm for the 2002/2023 additions to the RD, so at --std 85 CODE IS "AB", PAGE 60 LINES 132 COLUMNS, PAGE 132 COLUMNS (no integer-1), LAST CONTROL HEADING 20, LAST CH 20, FIRST DE 5, LAST DE 50, HEADING IS 1, FOOTING IS 55, PAGE IS 60 and PAGE ARE 60 all compile and run. Refusal probes that hold: PAGE HEADING 1 (no integer-1), empty CONTROL IS, empty PAGE (parse errors), CODE/CONTROL/PAGE/HEADING written twice. kb/Work PB5242 holds the defect (code read: coderead-85/out-reread2/rr-03.json).

next.reason: 1985 RD: 'RD report-name-1 [CODE literal-1] [CONTROL ...] [PAGE LIMIT integer-1 LINE [HEADING integer-2] [FIRST DETAIL integer-3] [LAST DETAIL integer-4] [FOOTING integer-5]]' (§1985:XIII.3.5.2). 2023 RD is 'RD report-name-1 [IS GLOBAL] [code-clause] [control-clause] [page-clause]' (§2023:13.14.2); IS GLOBAL is no change, 1985 already has it (§1985:X.4.4.2). CONTROL is unchanged (§2023:13.18.16.2). But CODE now takes 'CODE IS {literal-1 | identifier-1}' (§2023:13.18.12.2), and PAGE adds a COLS/COLUMNS width with integer-1 optional (§2023:13.18.39.2; 'Either integer-1 or integer-2 or both shall be specified', §2023:13.18.39.3 SR2; phrases only with integer-1, SR3), LAST CONTROL HEADING and the DE/CH synonyms (§2023:13.18.39.3 SR1). 1985 entries keep their meaning; 2023 accepts entries the 1985 format refuses (looser).
